content: Confirmed no JSONField references in admin currently; readonly models.JSONField falls through display_for_field to display_for_value, str(value) gives Python dict repr. Need add case for models.JSONField before else. Candidate minimal fix: json.dumps(value, cls=field.encoder), but PR approach prefers field.formfield().prepare_value(value) to handle InvalidJSONInput. Model JSONField lacks prepare_value; alternatives: field.formfield() (may default to forms.CharField) or forms.JSONField(encoder=field.encoder, decoder=field.decoder).prepare_value(value), but that instantiates per call. Unsure whether models.JSONField overrides formfield with forms.JSONField. Next: inspect django/forms/fields.py for JSONField.
